name: Kunszállás (Hungary)
description: Blue field with a white inverted V-shaped band rising from the lower corners to the top centre, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kunszállás (a crowned shield of red, blue and white with a figure, a tent and a lamb) above the name KUNSZÁLLÁS in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
